title: 菊花（秋丛绕舍似陶家）
author: 元稹
intro: Why love chrysanthemums? Not because they are the loveliest flower, the poet says — but because once they have finished blooming, there are no flowers left at all.
analysis: 这是一首咏菊的小诗。第一句说：屋子四周开满了秋菊，好像到了陶渊明的家——东晋诗人陶渊明最爱菊花，写过“采菊东篱下”，从此菊花和他分不开。第二句写诗人绕着篱笆一圈一圈地看，不知不觉太阳都快落山了，看得入迷。后两句说出爱菊的理由，很特别：不是我在所有花里偏爱菊花，而是菊花开完以后，一年里就再也没有花了。菊花在深秋开放，是一年中最后的花，所以格外值得珍惜。诗人没有直接夸菊花美，而是从“最后”这个角度说，既新奇又有道理。很多人也从中读出菊花不怕寒冷、开到最后的品格。
analysisEn: This short poem is in praise of chrysanthemums. Line one: autumn clumps of them circle the house, as if this were the home of Tao Yuanming — the 4th–5th-century poet who loved chrysanthemums and wrote “I pick chrysanthemums by the eastern fence”; ever since, the flower has been tied to his name. Line two: the poet walks round and round the hedge looking at them until, without noticing, the sun is sinking — he is completely absorbed. The last two lines give an unusual reason for his love: it is not that he favours the chrysanthemum above all flowers, but that once it has finished blooming, there are no more flowers for the rest of the year. Chrysanthemums open in late autumn, the last bloom of the year, so they are all the more precious. Instead of simply calling them beautiful, he praises them for being last — fresh and convincing at once. Many readers also see in it the flower’s strength: braving the cold and blooming to the very end.
background: Yuan Zhen (779–831) was a Tang official and poet, close friend of Bai Juyi, with whom he championed plain, accessible verse. The date of this poem is unknown.
pronunciation: 日渐斜：按统编教材对“斜”的现行注音读 xié；古音读 xiá，与“家”“花”押韵，旧时吟诵多读 xiá。绕舍 shè（房屋）；更无 gèng。
version: 采用通行教材文本，各版本基本无异文。题目原为《菊花》，因同名诗多，网站加首句区分。

lines.py: qiū cóng rào shè sì táo jiā
lines.lit: Autumn clumps surround the house, like Tao’s home;
lines.en: Autumn blooms ring my cottage — it could be Tao Yuanming’s home;

lines.py: biàn rào lí biān rì jiàn xié
lines.lit: all round the fence I circle, the sun gradually slanting.
lines.en: I circle the fence again and again till the sun hangs low.

lines.py: bù shì huā zhōng piān ài jú
lines.lit: It is not that among flowers I especially love the chrysanthemum;
lines.en: It isn’t that I love this flower more than all the rest —

lines.py: cǐ huā kāi jìn gèng wú huā
lines.lit: when this flower has finished blooming, there are no more flowers.
lines.en: but when it is done blooming, there are no flowers left.

words.note: “丛”= 一簇簇；现代汉语“草丛”“花丛”。
读 shè；现代汉语“宿舍”“校舍”。读 shě 是“舍得”。
陶渊明爱菊，“陶家”成了种满菊花的人家的代称。
“更”= 再；现代汉语说“再也没有”。

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: 菊花是一年里最后开的花，因此格外珍贵；又让人想到爱菊的陶渊明和他的隐逸生活。
imagery.en: The chrysanthemum is the last flower of the year, so all the more precious — and it recalls Tao Yuanming and his quiet country life.

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: 太阳渐渐西斜，说明诗人看菊看了很久，也暗示一年已到深秋。
imagery.en: The sinking sun shows how long he has been gazing — and hints that the year, too, is near its end.
